subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers adopt this issue as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella, or narrow the remaining work back to the existing bug-specific reports?
rationale: Source evidence confirms the problem class, but the proposed solution chooses lifecycle ownership, liveness policy, persistence, and Codex-wrapper behavior across stable gateway surfaces.

options.title: Adopt staged umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as the owner-approved direction and land Track A-D as small PRs with source and live proof.

options.title: Approve only Track A/B
options.body: Treat abort-to-release and evidence-based liveness as the near-term direction while deferring durability and completion-drive policy.

options.title: Keep reports separate
options.body: Decline the umbrella and continue resolving the linked production reports as separate narrow fixes.

recommendation.title: Adopt staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as the owner-approved direction and land Track A-D as small PRs with source and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored, self-assigned, and is already driving the linked implementation PRs for this design.
